ratings.note: P0s that need the owner's decision show up only in some fix runs, but with no 'blocked on a decision' status a P0 that was triaged looks untouched in the register, the owner's question lives only in the chat and not in the saved record, the outcome check fails even though the agent did the right thing, and the no-deferral rule pushes agents to guess a fix in high-stakes areas like dosing, so only a tool change can avoid it.
